label: Intro
text: Deploy apps and static sites on hosted Carloku, or run CARLOS Platform in your own infrastructure.
context: Text in the hero section of this page.

label: Note
text: App requests go to regional edges. Deployment metadata and tenant backups live in separate buckets.
context: Text in the diagram section of this page.

label: Body
text: Deploy apps and static sites with signed releases and named channels. Create branch previews, promote through bake windows and approvals, and roll back to an earlier release. Use zero-downtime swaps on configured hosts.
context: Text in the ship section of this page.

label: Body
text: Place tenant instances by region. Hibernate idle apps and wake them on request. Use one-way read replicas, customer-owned fleets and optional sidecars. Run scheduled jobs and one-off commands.
context: Text in the run section of this page.

label: Body
text: Custom domains, automatic TLS certificates, secrets, environment configuration and feature flags. Approved object storage with malware scanning, plus email with verified domains and delivery events.
context: Text in the services section of this page.

label: Body
text: Use scoped credentials for automation. Follow logs, grouped errors, availability and optional cookieless analytics. Roll platform updates out in stages.
context: Text in the operate section of this page.

label: Body
text: Litestream streams tenant SQLite changes to regional S3 storage. Restore databases or inspect earlier points in time.
context: Text in the data section of this page.

label: Body
text: Run compute on your own infrastructure. Current integrations use AWS S3, SES email and Route 53 steering.
context: Text in the hosting section of this page.
